items.title: Peter LaCaze Interview, 1972-01-27
items.q: The interviewer mentions Harrison Barnes was in a band, but the interviewee does not respond with any personal connection or memory regarding him.

ctx.x: Well, Riccardo-Lexis, him and I was pretty good friends, and we played together in places, you know, uh, on Exceptional's, you know, if we had an exception we might play together. And then we played the street together too. I see. Yeah. What about Harrison Barnes?
Yeah, uh huh. He was a block in one of the old bands, Enola.
